subject: ClearLake SOC2 / SIG - SSO & SCIM evidence + least-privilege artifacts
messages:
From: Jane Morris <security@clearlake.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: SAML assertions, SCIM delta, role inventory (SOC2 timeline)

Hi Jordan,

As part of ClearLake's SOC 2 scoping for our use of Redwood, our security team needs samples and artifacts to validate access controls. Specifically we need:
- A small set (10-20) of SAML assertion samples for successful and failed logins (redacted as needed).
- A SCIM delta log covering a 7-day window showing adds/mods/removals (CSV or JSON).
- Role-to-permission mapping and a service-account inventory (names, owner, last-used).
- Short notes on RBAC policy enforcement and any automated provisioning (SCIM) playbooks.

We'd like to complete review by Aug 25. Can you share a delivery plan and approximate ETA? Also please indicate any items requiring redaction or separate handling.

Thanks,
Jane Morris
Senior InfoSec Analyst
ClearLake Therapeutics
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Morris <security@clearlake.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SAML assertions, SCIM delta, role inventory (SOC2 timeline)

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on scope and can deliver a compact evidence package ahead of your Aug 25 target. High-level plan: 

1) By Aug 14: intake checklist + redaction policy and a short timeline.
2) By Aug 17: SAML assertion samples + SCIM delta sample (7-day window).
3) By Aug 18: role/permission mapping and service-account inventory CSV.

Laura (IAM) and Priyom (access proofs) are on this thread — they'll prepare the exports and call out anything that must be redacted.

Would you like a 30-minute walkthrough after we drop the Drive folder? If so, propose Aug 18 morning PT.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-13T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearLake evidence request — action items and redaction guidance

Laura / Priyom — forwarding ClearLake's ask. Action items below: 
- Laura: generate 10 SAML assertion samples (mix of success/failed), remove any PII (SSO NameIDs -> hashed or replaced), annotate assertion timestamps and relying-party entity IDs.
- Priyom: export a 7-day SCIM delta covering Aug 4-10 (adds/mods/deletes) with actor and timestamp columns. Also produce service-account inventory with owner and last-used time.
- Both: provide a 1-page note describing our RBAC enforcement (how we evaluate role membership, provisioning flow and where SCIM runs).

Deadline for drop to Drive: Aug 17 EOD PT. If anything requires legal/privileged handling, flag it immediately.

Thanks — Jordan
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-14T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearLake evidence request — artifact readiness

Quick status: I've started the extractions. Planned deliverables: 
- saml-assertions-samples.txt (10 assertions: 8 successful, 2 failed). NameIDs will be hashed; we will provide a mapping table (hash->placeholder) in the readme.
- scim-delta-sample.csv (7-day window Aug 4-10) with columns: timestamp, actor, op, target_type, target_id (redacted), details.
- service-account-inventory.csv (service_account, owner_email, role, last_used_iso) — no keys included.
- short RBAC_note.md describing enforcement and where least-privilege checks happen (policy code pointers).

I'll place everything in Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cClearlakeEvidence and mark files with a CLEARLAKE_README.txt explaining redactions. Attachments (stubs) included below.

Attachments referenced: clearlake-intake-checklist.pdf, scim-delta-sample.csv, saml-assertions-samples.txt, service-account-inventory.csv

—Laura
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearLake evidence request — extraction notes and sample size

Couple of clarifications before we hand off: 
- For SCIM delta: do they want full attribute dumps or only identity lifecycle events (joiner/mover/leaver)? I recommend lifecycle events only to avoid exposing profile attributes.
- For SAML assertions: we'll include both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated examples where applicable. We'll redact NameIDs but include entity IDs and assertion IDs.
- Service accounts: we'll include last-used within 90 days and owner. Not including any key material.

If ClearLake needs deeper telemetry (session origination logs) we should surface that as a separate deliverable and propose an NDA addendum; otherwise the above should satisfy SOC2 evidence.

I'll prepare the SCIM CSV sample and a short extraction README describing the query used.

—Priyom
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Morris <security@clearlake.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, procurement@clearlake.com
Date: 2026-08-18T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Delivery: ClearLake access evidence package (SAML, SCIM, RBAC notes)

Hi Jane — we uploaded a compact evidence package to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cClearlakeEvidence 

Contents (summary):
- saml-assertions-samples.txt (10 assertion stubs, success+failed, NameIDs hashed).
- scim-delta-sample.csv (Aug 4–10 lifecycle events only: add/modify/delete with actor/time).
- service-account-inventory.csv (service_account, owner_email, role, last_used_iso).
- RBAC_note.md (1 page summary of enforcement and least-privilege posture).
- CLEARLAKE_README.txt (redaction policy and extraction queries).

If you'd like the 30-minute walkthrough, I'm available Aug 19 09:00–11:00 PT. Otherwise we can keep this thread for Q&A.

Thanks — looking forward to closure.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: clearlake-intake-checklist.pdf, scim-delta-sample.csv, saml-assertions-samples.txt, service-account-inventory.csv
